mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% for two consecutive months predicts a near-term monetary tightening anticipation, which compresses equity discount rates and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% and remains above for ≥2 consecutive months
regime_hint: rising inflation surprise in a tightening cycle
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the trigger period (t-test p > 0.05), or CPIAUCSL reverts below 0.3% within 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS labor compensation growth exceeding 0.5% for three consecutive months signals strong wage growth expectations, which elevates equity risk premia and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS monthly growth > 0.5% for ≥3 consecutive months
regime_hint: labor market strengthening in expansionary phase
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or flat during the trigger window, or monthly PAYEMS growth reverts below 0.5% within 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly drop in HOUST industrial production index below -2% for two consecutive months indicates weakening manufacturing demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below -2% for ≥2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during the trigger, or HOUST recovers ≥2% within 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO supply index below 95 for three consecutive months reflects softening supply conditions, which raises uncertainty and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or flat during the trigger, or INDPRO recovers to ≥100 within 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 4.25% for two consecutive months, the S&P 500 is expected to underperform over the next 60 trading days due to higher real borrowing costs and reduced risk appetite.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.25% and remains above for ≥2 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically negative (t-test p > 0.05) during the trigger, or FEDFUNDS reverts below 4.25% within 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained interaction between a rising UNRATE (unemployment rate) and a declining PAYEMS (labor compensation growth) suggests a dual labor market stress, which elevates recession risk and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases while PAYEMS decreases for ≥3 consecutive months
regime_hint: labor market disalignment in contractionary phase
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or flat during the interaction window, or UNRATE and PAYEMS move in the same direction for ≥3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A two-month consecutive decline in RSAFS retail sales (monthly) combined with a rise in GDPC1 consumer demand index above 2% signals a late-cycle demand surge that temporarily boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < prev two months AND GDPC1 > 2% for ≥2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05), or GDPC1 falls below 2% within 1 month after trigger.

mechanism_narrative: When supply-side pressures persist (INDPRO < 95 for 4 consecutive months) in a low-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL < 102), S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days are expected to be negative due to elevated uncertainty and valuation compression.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 95 for ≥4 consecutive months AND CPIAUCSL < 102 for ≥3 consecutive months
regime_hint: persistent supply shock in low-inflation environment
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive or flat during the trigger, or CPIAUCSL rises above 102 within 2 months while INDPRO recovers ≥100 within 3 months.
